line_items.work_text: Immediate measures for closing of breach of Gainadi R/B embankment D/S of NH-15 from ch. 1445.00 m to ch.1620 m under SDRF for 2020-21
Immediate measures for closing of breach to the M/E along L/B of river Kumatiya from NH 15 to Gurathali chapori under SDRF for 2020-21 (From Ch. 3916 m to Ch.4036 m at Jungle block)
Immediate measures for closing of breach to the M/E along R/B of river Kumatiya from Nepali basti to Gurathali chapori under SDRF for 2020-21 (From Ch. 18720m to Ch.19050m at Sapekhaiti)
Immediate measures to close the breach at Hawaipur including restoration of right bank of Kopili dyke from Kharkhana to Jugijan in between Ch. 18000 m to Ch. 23000 under SDRF for 2020-21

narrative: SEC approved an amount of Rs. 216.00 Cr. for Water Resource Department against 105 nos of SDRF proposal for the year 2020-21.
